Bruno Mars appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

Bruno Mars actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or Bruno Mars's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of Bruno Mars’s anticipated performance at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027. A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Bruno Mars is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Bruno Mars performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Bruno Mars is present and actively performing, even if Bruno Mars's portion is partial.

A performance in which Bruno Mars performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.
